title: Issue and restore user sessions
description: Adds a session helper that mints an id for a freshly authenticated user and restores an existing session from the value stored in the user's cookie.

expected.note: The session id is derived from Math.random(), which is not cryptographically secure and is predictable enough to guess or collide. Use crypto.randomUUID() or crypto.getRandomValues() for the token.

The cookie value is parsed with JSON.parse and no try/catch, so any malformed or attacker-supplied cookie throws and crashes the request handler. Wrap the parse and validate the decoded shape before trusting it.
